verify.title: Verify your email address
verify.intro: Hi {user}, click the button to confirm this is your email address for {site}.
verify.footer: The link works for 24 hours. Didn't ask for this? Then you can ignore this mail.
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.intro: Hi {user}, someone (hopefully you) asked to reset your password for {site}. Click the button to choose a new one.
reset.footer: The link works for 1 hour and only once. Didn't ask for this? Ignore this mail; your password stays the same.
invite.title: You're invited
invite.intro: {admin} made an account for you on {site}. Your username is {user}. Click the button to choose your password.
invite.footer: The link works for 3 days and only once.
test.title: Test mail
test.intro: Email from your login portal works. Verification and password-reset mails will look like this.
